_comment: M-DEPTH DP4 canonical: the Watch barracks + market-depth stalls, one continuous run. FIXTURE-FIRST (near_barracks -- post_tutorial_street's exact state plus gold:25, so the peddler's mini-buy is provable live without an in-script earn-grind; that mechanic is already proven elsewhere by economy_loop/inventory_loop). Proves, in order: (1) the new bread_stall (flavor/observe, pays off Pisces's pre-existing 'the bread stall raises its prices' line with a real entity); (2) the peddler's mini-buy (watch_issue_gambeson, 20g, krshia_crate's exact buy contract -- gold_changed/toast/item_gained in the same emission order economy_loop's Krshia buy already proved); (3) barracks_door's real transition (the former watch_guard flavor spot -- zero canonical QA touches confirmed by grep before this task, so removing him is a silent change; see the task report); (4) Duty Sergeant Dresk Ashgrave's talk_pool line; (5) Zevara's desk (flavor/observe -- she herself stays at the gate, zevara_intro untouched); (6) THE CELL (locked_toast, empty-v1 dressed, a quest-outcome surface for later -- same skill-less-locked-prop seam as inn_upstairs's lyonette_door); (7) the round-trip back to the street, landing clear and open. Seed 9 for convention; fixture rng_state governs (no combat in this script).

steps._comment: Street payload unchanged by this task (confirmed against the actual event, not assumed) -- props/npcs never enter the static blocked_cells set (walls UNION the static `blocked` list only), and the grid size is untouched.
== (1) BREAD STALL == (1,3) right10 -> (11,3), up1 blocks on bread_stall (11,2) & faces it. Flavor/observe only, no buy -- pays off Pisces's pre-existing street line.

payload_contains.text: Warm bread smell over the whole row. No one's minding the stall this exact moment — the loaves aren't going anywhere without a fight.

steps._comment: == (2) PEDDLER'S MINI-BUY == (11,3) right7 -> (18,3), up1 blocks on peddler (18,2) & faces it. Buy option is index 0 (default cursor) -- press confirm immediately. Same emission order as economy_loop's Krshia buy: gold_changed BEFORE the 'Paid' toast, then item_gained.

payload_contains.speaker: Peddler
payload_contains.text: Deposit's already paid, so don't ask where it came from. Wear it in good health.

steps._comment: 'That's all.' (bought node index 1) closes the conversation.

== (3) INTO THE BARRACKS == (18,3) right3 -> (21,3), right1 blocks on barracks_door (22,3) & faces it (the former watch_guard flavor cell -- zero canonical QA touches on watch_guard were found before this task's move, confirmed by grep). to_cell (2,6) lands one cell north of barracks_exit (2,7), the same offset convention as guild_door/guild_exit.

Chronology mirrors guild_door/stairs_up: transition() fires map_changed synchronously, world.gd rebuilds the field (mood/map/entities) BEFORE wi_game.gd's interact() records on_enter_accomplishment -- visited_barracks asserted AFTER the render events.
4 entities (barracks_exit, duty_sergeant, zevara_desk, cell_door) + the PC's own sprite (world.gd's _count_visual(_player_visual, ...) call, the upstairs_walkthrough precedent) = 5.
MOOD CARD SHOT: the cool-institutional 'stern' barracks grade against the plank floor + kit-rack/briefing-table/crate dressing.
steps.name: 04_barracks_interior

steps._comment: == (4) DUTY SERGEANT == (2,6) up2 -> (2,4), right3 -> (5,4), right1 blocks on duty_sergeant (6,4) & faces it. talk_pool fires (first talk this waking) before any conversation graph -- Dresk carries no graph v1, inert-adjacent per the DP1 Yelra/Renn/Ilvo precedent.

payload_contains.speaker: Dresk
payload_contains.text: Sergeant Ashgrave. If you're here to report something, the slate's on the wall — write it plain.
Dresk: Sergeant Ashgrave. If you're here to report something, the slate's on the wall — write it plain.

steps._comment: == (5) ZEVARA'S DESK == (5,4) down1 -> (5,5), right4 -> (9,5), right1 blocks on zevara_desk (10,5) & faces it. Flavor/observe only -- she herself stays at the gate (zevara_intro untouched).

payload_contains.text: Watch Captain's desk. Empty, same as every other time you've walked past it.

steps._comment: == (6) THE CELL == (9,5) up2 -> (9,3), right2 -> (11,3), right1 blocks on cell_door (12,3) & faces it. No requires_skill -- a plain interact falls through use_skill('', id) to skill_unknown + the bespoke locked_toast, the exact sewer_debris/lyonette_door seam.

payload_contains.text: Barred, and empty behind the bars — you can tell by the quiet. Whatever ends up in here hasn't happened yet.

steps._comment: == (7) BACK TO THE STREET == (11,3) left9 -> (2,3), down3 -> (2,6), down1 blocks on barracks_exit (2,7) & faces it. Returns to street (21,3) -- open, clear of every entity (confirmed by this task's own blast-radius grep before placement).
